title: Manion
creator: CrossFit
description: Seven rounds of a 400 m run and 29 back squats at a light bar, for time. Honours U.S. Marine 1st Lt. Travis Manion, killed by sniper fire in Anbar Province, Iraq, in 2007. Two hundred squats in total, so pick a load you can move for big sets.
